about: Curated map from PokéAPI move identifiers to soccer traits. A species gets a move in pokedex.json kickMoves when any default-form learnset in any version group lists it. kick = striking with the legs or feet. reflex = a reactive block or guard, read as goalkeeping reflexes. header = striking with the head.

double-kick.reason: Two kicks in a row. Seeded by dispatch.

high-jump-kick.reason: Leaping knee kick. Seeded by dispatch.

rolling-kick.reason: Spinning roundhouse kick. Seeded by dispatch.

low-kick.reason: Low leg sweep kick. Seeded by dispatch.

triple-kick.reason: Three kicks in a row. Seeded by dispatch.

trop-kick.reason: Kick from the legs. Seeded by dispatch.

pyro-ball.reason: Kicks a fireball made from a pebble, the closest move to a shot. Seeded by dispatch.

axe-kick.reason: Raised heel brought down. Seeded by dispatch.

triple-axel.reason: Three spinning kicks. Seeded by dispatch.

mega-kick.reason: Added. A full-power kick, the most direct kicking move in the games.

low-sweep.reason: Added. A swift low sweep at the legs, a sliding-tackle analogue.

protect.reason: Blocks an incoming attack. Seeded by dispatch.

detect.reason: Reads and evades an attack. Seeded by dispatch.

quick-guard.reason: Blocks priority attacks. Seeded by dispatch.

wide-guard.reason: Blocks spread attacks. Seeded by dispatch.

obstruct.reason: Added. A blocking stance from the same Protect family.

silk-trap.reason: Added. A silk net block from the same Protect family.

burning-bulwark.reason: Added. A fiery shield block from the same Protect family.

mat-block.reason: Added. Lifts a mat to block attacks, a first-touch save.

crafty-shield.reason: Added. Shields the team from status moves, a team block.

headbutt.reason: Added. Rams with the head, the simplest header.

skull-bash.reason: Added. Tucks the head and rams.
